senses.gloss: m. (טלל, v. אַטְלֵיז) bazaar, shop, public place (cmp. חָנוּת).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:5">Gen. R. s. 19</cite>; s. 20 I shall die <he>ואתה יושב לך ה׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="E00318"><he>הטלים</he></cite>, corr. acc.), and thou wilt sit in public places (with none to care for)?—Pl. <he>הֶטְלֵיסִין</he>, <he>הוּטְ׳</he>. Ib. s. 37 <he>היו מעמידין ה׳</he> (some ed. <he>סון …</he>, corr. acc.) they arranged bazaars (with entertainments) where they would exchange their wives. Ib. s. 79 (ref. to <he>ויחן</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 33:18">Gen. XXXIII, 18</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="H01271"><he>חָנוּת</he></cite>) <he>התחיל מעמיד ה׳ וכ׳</he> he was the first to put up bazaars and sell cheap.
